wire.frames: Exactly existing durable_codec::encode_frame in record order; no durable file header or binding is synthesized.
wire.event_digest: Reconstructed from the exact canonical event by the original ledger. Encoder rejects any original LedgerRecord whose event_digest or other field differs from replay.
wire.limit_scope: Whole encoded snapshot, not each frame.
wire.parent_control_limit: Whole parent control message stays 65536 bytes, including metadata and any JSON/base64 overhead; caller must enforce it after actual serialization. The codec does not authorize chunking, a larger message, or truncated history.

encoder: Reject snapshot record count beyond the byte-derived maximum before allocation.
Before event clone/encoding, borrowed exhaustive match bounds candidate vectors at128, retrieval enumerated/legal512 and selected/delivered16, credit allocations256; StableId itself is bounded128.
Replay each original event through unchanged LearningLedger::prepare. Require Appended and exact entire LedgerRecord equality.
Reuse original encode_frame, reject aggregate length above65536 before append, then unchanged LearningLedger::apply.
Require replay head equal to supplied full snapshot head.
decoder: Reject input above65536 before parsing; require complete exact domain/header.
Validate record count against fixed byte-derived maximum and actual remaining length; never reserve a count-sized buffer.
Borrow each complete frame after checked length/complement/size validation; verify its original checksum.
Use original bounded decode_event; replay through original prepare and require Appended plus exact byte-for-byte original encode_frame equality.
Apply original prepared record; reject trailing bytes and require final replay head equal to header head.

authority.provides: Complete canonical content and causal ledger consistency only.
does_not_provide: Freshness, authenticity or permission to admit this ledger
Trust activation, a verified signed freeze, or source/task/plan/contract admission
Durable file, writer, lock, socket, process, execution, network or other authority
required_caller_behavior: Retain independently preheld full trust and the original exact freeze signature verification.
Bind original A/source/task/plan/contract context before first Root admission.
Do not substitute an already held caller-side replay for actual first-admission material or proof of provenance.
Reject any outer aggregate control overflow; do not drop records or relax the codec.

integration.public_registration: Two new public readonly codec functions require accurate caller/boundary registration when integrated; no final full-body fence is frozen before actual formatting.
integration.exact_lib_inverse: Deleting the single module mount and four exports restores original c9bfc bytes.
